methodologyNotes: Self-serve USD pricing fetched from each vendor's official pricing page on 2026-06-15. monthlyUsd reflects the effective monthly cost on annual billing (smallest paid unit) as required by schema; month-to-month rates are noted in plan notes where known. annualDiscountPct is calculated where both billing periods are published. Cal.com annual prices ($12/$28) are billed annually with 25% savings vs month-to-month (~$16/$37). SavvyCal annual billing offers '2 months free' (~16.7% off); $10/$17 are month-to-month rates, annual effective ~$8.33/$14.17. Motion positions itself as an AI task/calendar planner with scheduling-link functionality; included because it is a direct Calendly competitor in self-serve scheduling. Zcal pricing page is JS-rendered and returned only navigation markup on direct fetch; price sourced from Zapier's 2026 scheduling-app roundup (zapier.com/blog/best-meeting-scheduler-apps, accessed 2026-06-15). YouCanBookMe pricing page is JS-rendered with all prices shown as '$0' placeholder (no USD figures extractable from HTML); multiple fallback sources (alternativeto.net mentions 'up to $14/month' without plan breakdown) did not yield verifiable per-plan USD figures; monthlyUsd set to null for all paid plans per methodology. TidyCal lifetime plans are one-time payments, not recurring; monthlyUsd set to null for lifetime tiers and the effective monthly rate of the Pro subscription is recorded. minutesIncluded/callsIncluded/overagePerMin/overagePerCall are null on all plans (non-telephony product category).

vendors.name: Calendly
vendors.provenance: https://calendly.com/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-15); HIPAA/BAA status confirmed via https://calendly.com/security (accessed 2026-06-15) — SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, PCI-compliant; no HIPAA mention.

plans.name: Free

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $10/seat/month on annual billing (save 16%). Month-to-month rate approximately $12/seat. Unlimited event types, multiple calendar connections, Stripe/PayPal payments, Zapier, automated reminders, 24/7 chat support.

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: $16/seat/month on annual billing (save 20%). Month-to-month approximately $20/seat. All Standard features plus Salesforce routing, round-robin scheduling, advanced admin, SSO add-on.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only; starts at $15,000/year. SAML/SSO, domain control, audit logs, dedicated support, data deletion API.

limits: Free: 1 event type, 1 calendar connection; Standard: unlimited event types, multiple calendars ($10/seat/mo); Teams: adds Salesforce + round-robin ($16/seat/mo); Enterprise: from $15,000/yr
enrichment.provenance: Verified against Calendly's public pricing and security pages (2026-06-15). Security page lists SOC 2 Type II, SOC 3, GDPR, CCPA, ISO/IEC 27001, CSA STAR L1, and PCI; HIPAA/BAA is NOT mentioned, so hipaa=false. Free-forever plan confirmed (14-day paid trial auto-downgrades to Free).

enrichment.provenance: Verified 2026-06-15. SavvyCal's security page explicitly states it does NOT hold SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA itself ('we don't hold them at this time. Our core infrastructure providers do') — so soc2=false, hipaa=false. The security page does NOT mention GDPR; gdpr=true is sourced from the published DPA (Module 2 SCCs, Irish Data Protection Commissioner as supervisory authority, named Privacy Officer), hence compliance.source points to the DPA, not the security page. No free-forever plan; Basic $10 / Premium $17 with 30-day money-back.

vendors.name: YouCanBook.me
vendors.provenance: https://youcanbook.me/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-15). Page is JavaScript-rendered: plan names and feature tiers are visible (Free, Individual, Professional, Team) but all dollar prices render as '$0' placeholder in static HTML — no USD figures were extractable from the authoritative source. Third-party guides were checked and CONFLICT, so no figure meets the confirmation bar: zeeg.me/en/blog/post/youcanbookme-pricing-features quotes Individual ~$7/Professional ~$10/Team ~$14 per member (annual); other roundups quote Individual $9/Professional $13/Team $18 (month-to-month); schedulingkit.com describes a single ~$14/month paid plan priced per calendar connection (not per user). Because sources disagree on both the figures and the unit (per-user vs per-calendar), monthlyUsd is set to null for all paid plans per methodology (cannot independently confirm).
